name: 087.3 — a collection destroys its member
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 087.3: hafen.session():remove(s) ends a login and hands the collection back, session.close opens it and s:close() alike, both refuse an account nobody holds in the same words, a string is refused naming a Session, a key this addon did not declare still refuses before its receiver is resolved, no refusal drops anything, and the endings conventions.md now names each answer their receiver.
